import os
import tempfile
from s7_todo import TodoList

def test_save_load():
    # Create a TodoList and add some items
    todo_list = TodoList()
    id1 = todo_list.add("Buy milk")
    id2 = todo_list.add("Walk dog")
    todo_list.done(id1)
    
    # Create a temporary file path
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(mode='w', delete=False, suffix='.json') as f:
        temp_file_path = f.name
    
    try:
        # Save the TodoList
        todo_list.save(temp_file_path)
        
        # Load a new TodoList from the saved file
        loaded_list = TodoList.load(temp_file_path)
        
        # Verify the loaded list has the same todos and next_id
        assert loaded_list.todos == todo_list.todos
        assert loaded_list.next_id == todo_list.next_id
        
        # Verify the pending items are correct
        assert loaded_list.pending() == ["Walk dog"]
        
        # Add a new item to the loaded list to verify next_id is preserved
        id3 = loaded_list.add("Buy bread")
        assert id3 == 3  # Should be 3 since next_id was 3
        
        # Verify the new item was added
        assert loaded_list.pending() == ["Walk dog", "Buy bread"]
        
        print("Save/load test passed!")
        
    finally:
        # Clean up the temporary file
        os.unlink(temp_file_path)

# Run the save/load test
test_save_load()
